label: Peplink AP One AX Wi-Fi 6 access point (APO-AX)
description: Peplink AP One AX - ceiling-mount dual-band Wi-Fi 6 access point with a single 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port, 4x4 MU-MIMO on both radios (2.4 GHz to 1148 Mbps, 5 GHz to 2400 Mbps), built-in omni antennas, plenum-rated enclosure. Powered by 12 V DC jack or 802.3at PoE, 23 W maximum.
notes: The port table is explicit: **'1x 2.5 Multigigabit Ethernet'** - one port, not four, and 2.5G rather than 1G - so this AP needs a 2.5G switch port or it runs at 1G, which is exactly the kind of one-line fact a spec sheet invents wrongly. The 802.3at PoE input is a footnote on the vendor page ('PoE Injector is available separately') and the draw is 23 W max, so `poeIn` is 23: a switch rated 802.3af (15.4 W) cannot power this AP, while 802.3at (25.5 W at the PSE) can - the engine will say so. Radio rates are quoted per band (4x4 2.4 GHz to 1148 Mbps, 5 GHz to 2400 Mbps) rather than inferred from the Wi-Fi class. Bridge and NAT router modes are both supported, which is why `l2-forward` and `nat` are both declared; management is web admin, InControl and SNMP - no console, so no `cli`.
